statements.markdown: **Proposition 7.5.** Let $S>0$. The operator $\mathcal T_S$ is a bijection of $\mathcal D_S$ onto $\mathcal H_{\mathrm{div}}$, and of $\mathcal D_S^\Gamma$ onto $\mathcal H_{\mathrm{div}}^\Gamma$. Moreover, if $S_k\to S$ in $(0,\infty)$ and $f_k\to f$ weakly in $\mathcal H_{\mathrm{div}}$, then $v_k=\mathcal T_{S_k}^{-1}f_k$ and $v=\mathcal T_S^{-1}f$ satisfy $\nabla v_k\to\nabla v$ and $\Delta v_k\to\Delta v$ weakly in $\mathcal H$, and $v_k\to v$ in $L^2((0,1)\times B_r)$ for every $r>0$.
